text:
Lina Chen: Drafting changelog for v0.9.3. Scope: streaming reliability fix, routing fallback tweak, new `dedupe` query param, plus a known-issues entry for embeddings indexer truncation (>8k sequences). Need snippets (Py/TS), a short migration note for model pinning, and a tiny troubleshooting blurb. Can someone own coordinating PRs and the final changelog doc?

Oliver Kim: I can shepherd the docs PRs and link them into the changelog. I'll also verify the canary guidance for routing fallback.

Priya Desai: I'll update SDK snippets (python + typescript) and add a small migration section about pinning model versions and the new `dedupe` param. Will include short sync/stream examples.

Tyler Nguyen: On infra side: I'll confirm runtime params for streaming (`chunked=true`) and provide the expected event pattern; also will capture quick logs for verification.

Lina Chen: Great. For known issues we need a concise workaround: embeddings indexer may drop items when sequences exceed 8k tokens; propose workaround: set `chunk_size <= 4096` and enable prefix caching. Add a link to ENG issue: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/10921

Oliver Kim: PRs to pull in: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8321 (streaming reliability) — needs example + short note, https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8340 (routing fallback) — needs changelog blurb + canary guidance, https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8355 (dedupe param) — API doc + snippet, https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8360 (embeddings indexer) — known_issues entry.

james (docs-bot): Automated: docs PR template check flagged #8340 for missing "known_issues" field. CI: https://ci.redwood/reports/8340

Priya Desai: I'll add the missing section and push updated snippets. Question: keep both sync + async py streaming examples? Make them minimal.

Tyler Nguyen: Yes, include both. For streaming show `client.generate({stream: true})` and a minimal handler. Call out three-event pattern: init, partial, done. Node example we prefer concise: ```js
const s = client.generate({model: 'redwood/kitefish', stream: true, chunked: true});
s.on('data', d => console.log(d.text));
```

Priya Desai: Sounds good. For Python streaming I'll use both sync + asyncio short snippets and truncate output in the example. Also adding a note on the dedupe param default behavior.

Oliver Kim: I'll assemble the changelog draft at docs/release/changelog-0.9.3.md with one-line bullets + links to PRs and a small "migration notes" section. Plan to include: short example for streaming, canary rollout tip for fallback, and the embeddings workaround reference.

Lina Chen: Timeline: get PRs open/updated by EOD tomorrow. If anything misses we push that feature's note to the next minor patch. Release target: schedule release-bot for 2026-03-25 09:00 PT once changelog and PRs are merged.

Oliver Kim: I'll post a checklist here when PRs are up: add snippets, migration blurb, known-issue entry, CI pass, review, merge.

Priya Desai: I'll ping when my snippet PR is created (aiming for 11:00 PT).

james (docs-bot): Automated: template re-check queued on push. Will report pass/fail.

Tyler Nguyen: I'll upload quick integration logs as attachments to the streaming PR and note expected event sequence.

Lina Chen: Thanks all. Once merged I'll run through the changelog and trigger the release-bot schedule. If someone wants to pair on wording for the migration note, ping me offline. :white_check_mark:
